method_names: Пикар + грубая сетка и групповая MC-поправка (3D)
metadata.method_name: Пикар + ЛОМ (направленные прогонки, 3D); Пикар + матричная прогонка (3D); Пикар + обычный MC (3D); Пикар + грубая сетка и MC-поправка (3D); Пикар + групповой MC (3D); Пикар + грубая сетка и групповая MC-поправка (3D)
metadata.applicability: Нелинейная нестационарная теплопроводность в 3D, условия 1 или 3 рода на каждой грани. k=1+αu², c=1+γu², источник F−σu³; α, γ, σ ≥ 0. Все варианты MC вычисляют полное поле на каждой итерации Пикара.
metadata.nonlinear_residual: ||A(u)u-rhs(u)||inf / fixed layer scale S; separate from analytic error

material_model.time_discretization: c(u_new)*(u_new-u_previous)/dt; implicit Euler, not an enthalpy difference
material_model.picard: freeze c(v), k(v), reaction_sigma*v^2; validate the original nonlinear residual

metadata.timing: Solver seconds include preparation, all physical layers, Picard iterations, and independent MC checks. JIT warmup_seconds, external references and UI/export are separate. Preparation, block assembly/factorization/solve and coarse/interpolation/defect times are subsets of solver seconds.
metadata.memory: workspace_bytes is an estimated numerical working set; peak_rss_bytes is null unless measured, never inferred from workspace_bytes.
metadata.reproduction: python -m pdelab.heat3d_cli study --case polynomial --n 8 --alpha 0.5 --capacity-gamma 0.5 --reaction-sigma 1.0 --dt 0.002 --T 0.004 --query field --methods lod block mc mc_control mc_grouped mc_control_grouped --tol 1e-06 --change-tol 1e-06 --linear-tol 1e-10 --relaxation 1.0 --max-outer 1 --max-inner 20000 --max-seconds 5.0 --max-workspace-bytes 268435456 --history-mode layers --conductivity-refresh-layers 4 --x0 3 --beta-x0 1.0 --x1 3 --beta-x1 1.0 --y0 3 --beta-y0 1.0 --y1 3 --beta-y1 1.0 --z0 3 --beta-z0 1.0 --z1 3 --beta-z1 1.0 --mc-tol 0.2 --mc-change-tol 0.1 --walks 1024 --coarse-n 4 --max-walks 1 --max-transitions 40000000 --max-path-steps 100000 --walk-budgets 256 1024 --batch-size 128 --repeats 5 --seed 31038 --margin 0.8 --budgets 0.001 1e-06 --out runs/heat3d-study
metadata.seed_usage: Each MC repeat starts the whole history from the prescribed initial data. Trial seeds derive from phase/candidate/repeat, and layer/outer/update-or-check select separate streams. Methods share trial seeds for paired comparisons.
